title: Interior Design Bratislava & Vienna | Renovation & Custom Furniture | DUMSKAYA DESIGN
description: DUMSKAYA DESIGN is an interior design studio in Bratislava serving Bratislava and Vienna. Apartment and house interior design, turnkey renovation, 3D visualization and custom furniture for residential and commercial interiors in Slovakia and Austria.

parts.html: My name is Irina Dumskaya, and I am pleased to welcome you to the world of unique and innovative interior design from the DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia. Our mission is to transform your space into a true reflection of your style, comfort and ambition. In every project we aim not only to create a beautiful interior but also to bring a part of your personality into it so that you feel truly at home every day.

In our work we combine a creative approach with technical precision to ensure that our projects are not only aesthetically appealing but also functional. We pride ourselves on listening carefully to our clients and turning their dreams into reality. Whether you are planning to decorate a cosy family home or a stylish commercial space, my team and I are ready to offer solutions that exceed your expectations.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia studio develops design projects with renovation and custom-made furniture from start to finish for apartments, cottages, townhouses, private country houses, villas, hotels, offices, shops and beauty salons.
I look forward to the opportunity to work with you and create something truly unique.
Head and lead designer of the DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia interior studio
What will you receive when you order a design project from DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia?

items: Unique solutions that reflect your style and way of life.
Consideration of all your wishes and needs.
Plans for plumbing equipment, underfloor heating, sockets and switches.
Plans for lighting equipment, ceilings and floors.
A full list of finishing materials and their quantities.
The ability to make adjustments to achieve the perfect result.
Site visits with a designer to select materials.
Author supervision to monitor project implementation.
From concept to completion – we take on all stages of the project, including developing furniture drawings and sections.
Professional oversight at every stage of the project.
Time savings and prevention of costly mistakes.

parts.html: By ordering a design project from DUMSKAYA DESIGN Bratislava, Slovakia, you receive not just an interior, but a space that reflects your uniqueness and will delight you every day.
